integrity.scientific_claim_scope: Exact inverse-pair rank-domination filtration and sharp free-word-degree cutoff.

limitations: Finite coefficient fields, one fixed nonhomogeneous generator and square evaluations only.
Finite test enumerations confirm examples; symbolic proof establishes the all-prime-power theorem.
Earlier equivalent formulations of polynomial annihilators in the literature remain possible.
title: Sharp finite-size rank-domination cutoff for a one-sided inverse relation over finite fields
